questions.title: As tigers spill beyond reserves, India rethinks conservation
questions.subject: environment
questions.q: With reference to “As tigers spill beyond reserves, India rethinks conservation”, consider the following statements:
items: Forty-five-year-old Mahadeva Gowda was tending to his cotton farm in the village of Badagalapura in the southern Indian state of Kerala when a tiger lunged at him from behind.

Before he realised Forty-five-year-old Mahadeva Gowda was tending to his cotton farm in the village of Badagalapura in the southern Indian state of Madhya Pradesh when a tiger lunged at him from behind.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: Statement 1 is incorrect: it is Karnataka, not Kerala. The report says: “Forty-five-year-old Mahadeva Gowda was tending to his cotton farm in the village of Badagalapura in the southern Indian state of Karnataka when a tiger lunged at him from behind.” Statement 2 is incorrect: it is Karnataka, not Madhya Pradesh. The report says: “Before he realised Forty-five-year-old Mahadeva Gowda was tending to his cotton farm in the village of Badagalapura in the southern Indian state of Karnataka when a tiger lunged at him from behind.”
